entities.summary: Adolf Mauritz Fonahn was a Norwegian physician, medical historian and orientalist. He is best known for his work including those revolving around Tibetan Buddhism, Leonardo da Vinci's anatomical drawings, early Persian and Arabic medical literature, and more generally the study of medical history and Asian languages.
